data.headline: 2024 election results, Fed meeting, earnings: What to Watch
data.summary: American voters will be on the edge of their seats, eagerly awaiting polling results of the 2024 presidential election race between Vice President Kamala Harris and former President Donald Trump. The Federal Reserve kicks off its November FOMC meeting this week as central bank officials convene in Washington, DC, on Wednesday, concluding with Fed Chair Jerome Powell discussing the central bank's latest interest rate decision in a press conference on Thursday, November 7. Top companies due to report earnings tomorrow, Wednesday, November 6, include Novo Nordisk (NVO), Toyota Motor Corp. (TM), Qualcomm (QCOM), Arm Holdings (ARM), CVS Health (CVS), and Take-Two Interactive (TTWO). To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination Overtime here. This post was written by Luke Carberry Mogan.
